name: conditional_into_agent_call
description: Tests a conditional step whose on_true branch is an agent_call rather than a plain tool_call: step_1 always outputs "success", so check always routes to call_greeter, spawning a real child run (greeter.json) as the result of a branching decision. Confirms canEnqueueStep's generic dependency check and spawnChildRun work together correctly when the step becoming enqueable is an agent_call, not just when it is enqueued unconditionally from the top of a run.
